products.name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream
products.description: Rich, creamy moisturizer with 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid to help restore the skin's natural barrier. Developed with dermatologists, this fragrance-free formula provides 24-hour hydration for dry to very dry skin. MVE Delivery Technology ensures continuous moisture release throughout the day.
products.excerpt: Rich moisturizer with 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid for 24-hour hydration.

products.name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1%
products.description: High-strength vitamin and mineral formula that targets visible blemishes and signs of congestion. Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) reduces the appearance of skin blemishes and congestion while zinc balances visible sebum activity. Water-based, alcohol-free, oil-free, silicone-free, vegan, and gluten-free.
products.excerpt: High-strength vitamin and mineral formula targeting visible blemishes and congestion.

products.name: La Roche-Posay Anthelios SPF 50+
products.description: Ultra-light, invisible fluid sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF 50+ UVA/UVB protection. Formulated with La Roche-Posay thermal spring water and Cell-Ox Shield technology. Non-greasy, non-comedogenic, and suitable for sensitive skin. Water-resistant up to 80 minutes.
products.excerpt: Ultra-light invisible fluid sunscreen with broad-spectrum SPF 50+ protection.

products.name: Bioderma Sensibio Micellar Water
products.description: Gentle no-rinse cleansing micellar water for sensitive skin. Fatty acid esters, the key ingredient of micelles, naturally interact with the skin's own biomechanisms. Removes makeup and impurities without irritation. Dermatologically tested. 500ml.
products.excerpt: Gentle no-rinse micellar water that removes makeup and impurities for sensitive skin.

products.name: Maybelline Instant Age Rewind Concealer
products.description: America's #1 concealer for a reason. Micro-corrector applicator instantly erases dark circles, smooths fine lines, and covers imperfections. Concentrated formula with goji berry and haloxyl. Available in 18 shades. Dermatologist-tested and ophthalmologist-tested.
products.excerpt: America's #1 concealer — instantly erases dark circles and covers imperfections.

products.name: NYX Soft Matte Lip Cream
products.description: Lightweight lip cream that glides on silky smooth and sets to a stunning matte finish. Infused with natural oils for comfortable long-wear. Plush, creamy texture delivers intense, vivid color without dryness. Available in 36 shades.
products.excerpt: Lightweight lip cream with silky smooth application and stunning matte finish.

products.name: L'Oréal True Match Foundation
products.description: Precise-match, flawless-look foundation with a natural finish. 45 true-to-skin shades ensure a perfect color match. Hydrating formula with hyaluronic acid smooths skin and provides medium-to-full buildable coverage that lasts up to 24 hours. Non-comedogenic, dermatologist-tested.
products.excerpt: Precise-match foundation with hyaluronic acid for 24-hour flawless coverage.

products.name: MAC Retro Matte Lipstick – Ruby Woo
products.description: The iconic vivid blue-red retro matte lipstick that's become a cult classic worldwide. Long-wearing, intensely pigmented matte formula delivers statement color. One of MAC's all-time best-selling shades. The perfect red for every skin tone.
products.excerpt: Iconic vivid blue-red retro matte lipstick — a cult-classic best-seller.

products.name: Olaplex No.3 Hair Perfector
products.description: At-home weekly treatment that reduces breakage and strengthens hair by repairing disulfide bonds broken by chemical, thermal, and mechanical damage. Patented bond-building technology. Suitable for all hair types. Vegan and cruelty-free.
products.excerpt: At-home weekly treatment that repairs bonds broken by chemical and thermal damage.

products.name: Moroccanoil Treatment Original
products.description: The iconic argan oil-infused hair treatment that started it all. Foundation for all hairstyling — conditions, detangles, and speeds up drying time. Rich in antioxidant argan oil, vitamins, and proteins to strengthen and add brilliant shine. Absorbs instantly.
products.excerpt: Iconic argan oil treatment that conditions, detangles, and adds brilliant shine.

products.name: Dove Intensive Repair Shampoo
products.description: Nourishing shampoo with keratin repair actives that penetrate deep to help repair visible signs of damage. Progressive nourishing formula gets better with every wash, leaving hair feeling stronger, smoother, and more resilient. Suitable for daily use.
products.excerpt: Nourishing shampoo with keratin actives that repair visible signs of damage.

products.name: Victoria's Secret Bombshell EDP
products.description: The world's bestselling fragrance — a sparkling mix of purple passion fruit, Shangri-La peony, and vanilla orchid. Seductive, effervescent scent opens with an irresistible burst of citrus and fruits, settling into a warm floral heart. 100ml Eau de Parfum.
products.excerpt: World's bestselling fragrance — sparkling passion fruit, peony, and vanilla orchid.

products.name: The Ordinary AHA 30% + BHA 2% Peeling Solution
products.description: 10-minute exfoliating facial with alpha hydroxy acids and beta hydroxy acids. Contains Tasmanian pepperberry derivative to help reduce irritation associated with acid use. Targets textural irregularities, dullness, and visible blemishes for brighter, smoother-looking skin.
products.excerpt: 10-minute exfoliating facial for brighter, smoother-looking skin.

products.name: CeraVe Hydrating Facial Cleanser
products.description: Non-foaming, gel-to-cream facial cleanser that removes dirt and excess oil without disrupting the skin's natural barrier. Contains 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid. Fragrance-free, non-comedogenic, suitable for normal-to-dry skin.
products.excerpt: Gentle gel-to-cream cleanser with ceramides that hydrates while removing impurities.

products.name: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Gel-Cream
products.description: Oil-free gel-cream moisturizer with hyaluronic acid — a hydrator naturally found in skin — that locks in hydration and keeps skin supple. Unique formula absorbs quickly like a gel but moisturizes like a cream. Non-comedogenic, dye-free, alcohol-free.
products.excerpt: Oil-free gel-cream with hyaluronic acid that hydrates skin without heaviness.

products.name: NARS Radiant Creamy Concealer
products.description: Award-winning concealer provides medium-to-full buildable coverage with a luminous finish. Multi-action formula enriched with botanical extracts that hydrate and smooth skin. Crease-proof, transfer-resistant wear. Available in 30 shades.
products.excerpt: Award-winning concealer with medium-to-full buildable coverage and luminous finish.

products.name: L'Oréal Elvive Total Repair 5 Conditioner
products.description: Restoring conditioner with protein and ceramide for damaged hair. Targets 5 signs of damage: split ends, dryness, roughness, dullness, and fragility. Lightweight formula detangles without weighing hair down. Clinically proven results after just one use.
products.excerpt: Restoring conditioner with protein and ceramide targeting 5 signs of damage.

products.name: Avène Thermal Spring Water Spray
products.description: Soothing, softening spray of Avène Thermal Spring Water — clinically proven to calm, restore, and soften skin. Unique low mineral content and neutral pH. Perfect as a refreshing face mist, post-procedure recovery, or setting spray. Suitable for all skin types.
products.excerpt: Soothing thermal spring water mist that calms, restores, and softens all skin types.
